props.name: children
props.description: Content that skews with the scroll speed.

props.name: skew
props.description: Degrees of skew at full speed.

props.name: drift
props.description: Pixels of horizontal drift at full speed.

props.name: squash
props.description: Vertical squash at full speed, as a scale delta.

props.name: ceiling
props.description: Scroll speed, in pixels per frame, that counts as full.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Drift and skew the other way — pair two rows for a shear effect.

props.name: scrollRef
props.description: Scroll container. Defaults to the window.
